hints.content:
Imagine that the plane slices the solid figure.  The slice cuts through the pyramid vertically and passes through the center of the pyramid.

What is the shape of the pyramid when you look at it from the side?
The pyramid looks like a triangle when sliced vertically through its center.

The shape of a vertical intersection  with the center of the pyramid is an isosceles triangle.
